title: End UI Overhaul
description: A fully custom End‑themed UI overhaul
body:

visual style across Minecraft’s user interface. The project focuses on clarity, readability, and visual cohesion while maintaining the structure and functionality of the original UI.

This pack replaces a wide range of interface elements with a unified purple aesthetic inspired by the End dimension. It is designed for players who prefer a clean, modern interface that enhances the overall presentation of the game without altering gameplay mechanics.

What This Pack Changes
Custom versions of the Mojang, Minecraft, and Java Edition logos

Recolored menus, buttons, and loading bars

Updated HUD elements, including hearts, hunger, armor, and the experience bar

A consistent End‑themed color palette applied across all interface components

Why This Pack May Be Useful
End UI Overhaul provides a complete visual refresh for players who want a more atmospheric and thematic interface. The design emphasizes consistency and readability, offering a distinct End‑inspired appearance while preserving the usability of the vanilla UI. It is suitable for players seeking a polished and cohesive interface experience.
